2609.23449.title: PSD: Pseudo Self-Distillation of Memory Representation Capabilities for LLM Agents
2609.23449.paper_summary: Memory systems are becoming a core component of LLM agents, but constructing and maintaining memory remains expensive because it relies on repeated calls to large proprietary language models. This cost creates a major barrier to deploying memory-enhanced agents at scale. In this paper, we present Pseudo Self-Distillation (PSD), a framework that enables small language models (SLMs) to construct hierarchical memory representations by distilling behavior from a strong black-box oracle through a multi-stage training pipeline. Standard distillation methods require access to teacher logits or hidden states, which closed models do not expose. Unlike conventional self-distillation settings, where supervision is derived from a model's own predictions, sampled rollouts, or aggregated outputs, PSD enables a single-model distillation setup while channeling external oracle knowledge through the prompt. PSD uses a single small model in two roles: a teacher that sees a privileged prompt containing the oracle's answer as reference context, and a student that sees only the task prompt. The student learns to reproduce the teacher's output distribution, absorbing oracle-guided behavior into its own weights without accessing the oracle's internals. On LoCoMo, PSD-trained Qwen3-0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B match or exceed GPT-4.1-mini on downstream retrieval at a fraction of the deployment cost, with off-policy PSD achieving the strongest results across most conditions. We further show that this memory-construction capability transfers out-of-distribution to LongMemEval, despite the students being trained exclusively on LoCoMo with no exposure to LongMemEval data.
2609.23449.paper_summary_zh: 記憶系統正成為大型語言模型（LLM）代理的核心組件，但構建和維護記憶仍然代價高昂，因為它依賴於對大型專有語言模型的重複調用。這種成本對於大規模部署增強記憶的代理構成了主要障礙。在本文中，我們提出了偽自蒸餾（Pseudo Self-Distillation，PSD），這是一個框架，能夠使小型語言模型（SLM）通過多階段訓練流程從強大的黑箱預言者中提煉行為，構建層次記憶表示。標準的蒸餾方法需要訪問教師的邏輯或隱藏狀態，而封閉模型並不公開這些信息。與傳統的自蒸餾設置不同，在這些設置中，監督來自模型自身的預測、抽樣回合或聚合輸出，PSD使得單模型蒸餾設置成為可能，同時通過提示通道引入外部預言者知識。PSD在兩個角色中使用單一小型模型：一個教師，看到包含預言者答案的特權提示作為參考上下文；一個學生，僅看到任務提示。學生學會重現教師的輸出分佈，將預言者引導的行為吸收進其自身的權重，而無需訪問預言者的內部。 在LoCoMo上，經PSD訓練的Qwen3-0.6B、1.7B和4B在下游檢索中與GPT-4.1-mini匹配或超越，且部署成本僅為其一小部分，離線政策PSD在大多數條件下達到最佳結果。我們進一步顯示，這一記憶構建能力在LongMemEval中轉移至分佈外，儘管學生僅在LoCoMo上訓練，未接觸LongMemEval數據。
